scope: Hypcade 0.1 signed release APKs with ROM-derived move tables covering all supported skills and operator difficulties, and corrected DL2 Watch Mode acceptance timing; not published.
project_description: Android arcade-focused fork and adaptation of Hypseus Singe
signing: Dedicated Hypcade release certificate; private key excluded from source archives

release_notices.packaging: External companion file; no license assets or license browser inside APK

source_distribution.repository_dependencies: Fetched by bootstrap-deps.py at dependencies.lock.json revisions; third_party checkouts are not committed.
source_distribution.complete_bundle: Pinned dependency sources remain included separately in complete source bundles. No new source archive was generated for these move-table changes.
source_distribution.excluded: Private keys, local settings, toolchain installations, caches, build outputs and game data.

packaging.abis: One ABI per flavor; arcade excludes touch controls; mobile includes them.
packaging.native_libraries: Compressed/extracted native libraries for SDL filesystem loading.
packaging.shrinking: R8 and resource shrinking enabled for release; ThinLTO native builds.
packaging.support_assets: Fonts, pictures and sounds read directly from APK. Only two input defaults (5447 bytes) extracted. WAV contents use lossless .wav.bin packaging.
packaging.notices: External companion file, not APK assets or an in-app license browser.

runtime.storage: Games read in place; private settings, saves and logs. Validate all clip indexes before play; publish beside writable media with private fallback.
runtime.video: Optional MediaCodec MPEG-2 reconstruction with ARM NEON/portable libmpeg2 recovery. Existing VLDP timing retained.
runtime.crt: Single-pass zfast-derived YUV/GLES shader; scanlines and mask follow output pixels. Plain-video fallback.
runtime.input: Global required arcade map; mobile requires touch or complete map. SDL gamepad mapping always enabled; optional Start 2 and Service bindings.
runtime.commands: Import matching commands once on discovery; saved GUI settings override supported switches; rescans preserve settings. Native -blend remains available.
runtime.guidance: DLE21 and Space Ace A3 use separately ranked ROM-state move sets, checked across all three Ace skills and four operator difficulties. Counterfactual execution and complete death-free replays validate sampled runtime contexts. Required zero-score ending actions remain included. DL2 US 3.19 uses its native ROM input records and earliest accepted phase; Singe retains its native menu.
runtime.scoreboard: Existing scorebezel for supported drivers; DL2 US 3.19 added using ROM RAM. Live DL2 counters and two-player behavior remain unverified.
runtime.configuration: Current schema only; no old-development-configuration migrations.
runtime.watch_mode: Enabled for games with matching bundled guidance. Repeats coin pulses until the game's credit counter changes, then retries Player 1 Start at spaced intervals until the ROM spends a credit or reports active lives. This handles coin ratios and input-ignoring startup delays. Dragon's Lair II waits for the ROM to consume each coin before sending another, avoiding a boot-time input backlog. Only Pause and Exit remain exposed while playback runs.
runtime.difficulty: DIP-controlled games share one catalog and reader/writer, with explicit choices initialized from effective bank settings and revision-specific native defaults. All Game default placeholders are removed. DL2 US 3.19 uses the existing -preset 0–4 hook and reads saved EEPROM difficulty; Space Ace has separate saved operator difficulty and skill.
runtime.mobile_service_menu: Raw Options / Service switch in the top touch-button row for Singe, Dragon's Lair II and Space Ace 91; hidden in Watch Mode. No automatic button combinations. Mobile touch controls use the same logical Android input dispatch as mapped arcade controls.
runtime.space_ace_difficulty: Original US Space Ace: four explicit native DIP combinations (after 3/5 consecutive episodes; slow/fast progression), initialized from effective -bank values and saved per game. Separate saved Cadet/Captain/Ace skill uses existing native skill inputs on Start. Neither control has a default placeholder. DIP-controlled games share one catalog and reader/writer; no additional native Space Ace code.
runtime.startup: Every game launch receives -nosplash, independently of Fast startup. The GUI fastboot switch controls only the upstream -fastboot ROM shortcut; native fastboot implementation is unchanged.
runtime.launcher_options: Options unsupported by the selected game/ROM are hidden, including Watch Mode, difficulty, skill, score/lives, fastboot, moves and cues. Assistance help is hidden when irrelevant. Reset controller is hidden without a saved mapping. Supported controls may be temporarily disabled while busy.

artwork.packaged_formats: WebP, API25 legacy drawable, API26 adaptive icon, TV banner
artwork.generation: Built-in image_gen tool; ImageMagick resource sizing/compression

validation.build: All four signed release flavors assembled; ARM arcade/mobile release lint passed with shared JDK 17 and pinned NDK/CMake.
validation.host: ROM tables/export, counterfactual score and death detection, guidance acceptance boundaries, required zero-score ending, launcher, Watch lifecycle and packaged evidence checks passed.
validation.packaging: All four APKs contain the verified move rows; signatures, SDK 25/36, version 0.1 and one ABI per flavor verified. Arcade/mobile touch-code and orientation policies passed.

dl2.negative_controls: Withholding first or final move causes a detected death on both backends.
dl2.scope: Previously verified DL2 decoder, CPU and Java player; unchanged by Cine branch-coverage and move-storage changes.

actual_apk.variant: Isolated debug APK with production native code; matching release sources cross-built and checked separately.

dle21.backend: actual Android 9 x86 APK through launcher
dle21.trace_scope: Boot through ending and exit; final field marks the completion boundary

space_ace.backend: actual Android 9 x86 APK through launcher
space_ace.trace_scope: Boot through ending and exit; final marks the completion boundary

dl2.method: Read-only process memory and Java input log; no memory writes or injected ROM moves
dl2.media: Synthetic black MPEG2 with original disc timing; not a commercial video/audio synchronization test
dl2.trace_scope: Ending portion; Java log covers the full session. Ending reached with all three starting lives.

validation.limitations: No physical ARM test, proof of global optimality or proof of every retry/random context. Space Ace and DL2 direct APK tests used synthetic MPEG2 timing media; DLE21 used original game media. Video-less Android runs are distinct from actual APK runs.
warnings: Existing native compiler warnings, including missing-override and logical operator parentheses.

attribution.changes: Copyright comments and About attribution only; existing upstream credits and licences retained.
attribution.limits: Gameplay reports retain the source fingerprints from their actual runs, before the attribution-only edits.
attribution.release_lint: Arcade and mobile release lint passed; existing warnings retained.

native_fastboot_comparison.scope: Static source comparison of ROM patches, boot/attract transitions, frame constants, flag accessors and command parser; no runtime speed benchmark.

move_generation.method: Revision-pinned ROM scene/step policies, natural execution and independent exact replay; extraction directly emits merged per-game files and the shared APK include, followed by unassisted Watch Mode checks.
move_generation.configuration: DLE21 plus Ace A3 Cadet/Captain/Ace at every operator difficulty, eight randomized starts per configuration and objective; Watch holdouts use separate randomized starts and varied input-queue phases.
move_generation.randomness: Seven or eight distinct scene/action sequences observed per configuration and objective across eight starts.
move_generation.storage: One merged JSON per game containing unique rows and both 16-bit policy index lists; native pools and indices need no runtime expansion.

build_resource_limits: Sequential Gradle invocations; max-workers=1, 1536 MiB heap and native compile pool=2.

settings_references.title: Cinematronics operations/maintenance manual, Appendix C, dated 2.3.84
settings_references.use: Original Space Ace A2/A3 DIP polarity and difficulty progression; facts only, manual not redistributed.

settings_references.title: MAME Dragon's Lair input-port definitions
settings_references.use: Dragon's Lair difficulty DIP combinations, including B8 forcing Easy in either mode.

source_tree_status: All four signed release APKs rebuilt with unsupported launcher options hidden and help text describing only available features. Every game continues to use -nosplash independently of native -fastboot. Launcher model checks and ARM release lint passed; signatures, SDK/ABI policies and removal of unavailable-option labels verified in all four compiled APKs. Native emulation and move tables are unchanged. No device UI or gameplay run was performed for this visibility change.
